title: Delivery arrives beyond the fee-refund threshold
facts_text: The latest delivery estimate in the app was 19:30, and the order arrived at 20:12, 42 minutes after that estimate. The order was delivered with no missing or damaged food items. I paid a delivery fee.
request: Please refund the delivery fee because my order arrived more than 30 minutes after the latest estimate.

strict.reason: The order arrived 42 minutes after the latest in-app estimate, exceeding the 30-minute threshold for a delivery-fee refund.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The base delivery-fee refund threshold is met; no exception is needed.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The late-item reporting discretion does not apply to this delivery-fee claim, and the base threshold is met.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Paired with uber_eats_004_late_delivery_below_threshold. Confirm the estimate is the latest in-app estimate and the time difference is exactly 42 minutes.
